title: K1 closed loop routes on the 45F with five seeds
label: TEST ONLY. Pre-registration committed before any v0.1.22 trim measurement or place-and-route. No Fmax and no trimmed cell count in this file. Power is needs real board. The v0.1.21 sweep verdict stays FAIL. This milestone does not claim a per-LUT win for K1. No other threshold changes.

locked_decisions.name: v0.1.22

flow.note: The 12 MHz flag is the target, not the result. Do not loosen the bound or change these flags.

fit.success: All five seeds route on LFE5U-45F and a five-seed median Fmax is reported. TRELLIS_COMB <= 37270. Decoder codes and K1 decision records stay bit-exact with the golden model.

baseline_from_v0121.note: Committed v0.1.21 nextpnr demand. Not a v0.1.22 measurement.

allowed_trims_in_order: Move register-file and bank storage in the W4 decoder and the W4 encoder into DP16KD.
Share or time-multiplex duplicated per-lane logic.
fit.bit_exact_rule: A trim that changes cycle behaviour or outputs ships as a new named variant (scp4d_tdec_s_w4_bram or scp4d_tenc_q_w4l8_bram) with its own golden vectors and an Icarus bit-exact check. The v0.1.19 designs and their recorded results stay byte-identical. Any variant reports its env T64 cycle count.
fit.stop_rule: If the trim cannot reach TRELLIS_COMB <= 37270, or the five seeds do not route, stop and report the best demand and the per-seed outcomes. Do not loosen the bound. Do not change the flags. Do not invent a fit.

verdict.PASS: All five seeds route and TRELLIS_COMB <= 37270.
verdict.MIXED: At least three of five seeds route, or all five route but TRELLIS_COMB is above 37270.
